title: crepis occidentalis subsp. pumila
intro: Crepis occidentalis subsp. pumila, commonly known as western sow thistle dwarf, is a subspecies of the Crepis occidentalis plant, belonging to the Asteraceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic agent, making it beneficial for treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Crepis occidentalis subsp. pumila include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
